_comment: THE CUSTOMER DIRECTORY (2026-09-07, rewritten on the author's reading of v1: 'ben normal sivil gece kulubu / pub / bar insani olusturmani istiyorum'). One row a person, decided once so the production run never has to decide it again: who they are (name, age, country, flag), how they talk (voice, an id in Resources/Data/voices.json), what they wear (dress = club / street casual / smart casual, look = the sentence a prompt is built from, garment = plain or one patterned piece (leopard, stripe, dot, palm, floral, shine, glitter, sequin, colourblock, tiedye, check, geo)), which gestures they answer with (cheer / upset / order, the styles in Tools/patron_trial_gen.py), and where their art stands ('art' is drawn / briefed / planned, 'inGame' is whether TycoonHud.PatronCast carries them). THREE RULES hold the list together: the room is MIAMI, so nobody wears a coat, a jacket or a hoodie - summer shirts, tees, crop tops, blouses and vests only: everybody is out for the night, so no work uniforms and nobody old; and the countries are the player base, four to five each outside the home crowd, with Miami's own population filling the rest. Tools/patron_roster.py reads this and reports the gap; the people cut in this rewrite are listed in 'retired' with the reason.

retired.why: a grandmother in a cardigan - the author named her as the example of what does not belong
a cleaner in a work polo
forty-four and dressed for a boat
a cook in whites and an apron
